story_variants.story_theme_en: Aom arranges oranges at the market in 5 rows. Each row has 7 items. The rows are equal, so Aom wants to know the total number of square units. This story practices Area of Rectangles. The children use real classroom objects to build the model before choosing the operation.
story_variants.helper_tip: Read the story, find the numbers, and choose the operation.
